name: receptance
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 频率域中以位移响应与作用力之间关系表征的动力柔度。
usage_overview: 用于从频域考察结构受力后的位移响应，识别共振特征，并比较不同支承形式及结构模型的动力差异。在车辆—轨道及土体模型分析中，也用于比较结构随频率变化的抗变形能力。

complete_examples.text: Therefore, one can chose either receptance of the left rail or the right rail.
Because of symmetry of the applied loads, the receptance on the left rail and right rail are the same.
Note that in such a case, the naming of receptance αi; j is not applicable.
Although the resonant frequencies of the receptance and the accelerance are different.
Firstly, the frequency response function (receptance) is introduced to analyze the characteristics of the FST at the frequency domain.
The receptance can be depicted through amplitude-frequency curve, so it is termed frequency response function as well.
To gain the sensitive characteristics of the coupled system in the frequency domain, the receptance of structure can be adopted.
